title: File:Parque Oncol-mirador y bosque.jpg
claims: A wooden viewing platform with red railings at the edge of dense Valdivian forest, with low misty hills beyond and a gravel clearing in the foreground; no trail markers or runners are visible. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file Parque Oncol-mirador y bosque.jpg. The route page uses it as Parque Oncol forest context near the Cafetería Oncol section; the platform is not the race trail, and the photograph is not race-day evidence.

The Commons author field reads Lin linao; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/); the relevant date is 2007-11-11; the file page gives no camera coordinates; the original is 994 × 651 px; 266,199 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 629 px; 119,524 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits Lin linao, CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
